memoryRule: two non-adjacent negative wells define a pressure span; each fold re-produces remote letter geometry, a transferred form, and an actual counterform; the latest four folds remain liftable
interactionRule: the first well load stays geometry-neutral; adjacent and repeated wells refuse; a second non-adjacent well commits; pointer, well buttons, arrows, Enter, Space, Delete, R, and Escape are deterministic equivalents
representationRupture: sentence sheet, route organism, and cadence score -> one irregular SVG typographic plate with negative wells, pressure seams, and a counterform
compositionRupture: monolithic sentence, connected station route, and three temporal columns -> one folded plane with a distributed material crease and no target-connecting path
encounterRupture: offer a letter, drag through stations, and tap a cadence -> load two non-adjacent blanks that define an interval
temporalRupture: sentence refusal stack, route custody, and cadence tempo -> accumulated material re-production from the already deformed plate
mediumRupture: semantic DOM text, inline SVG stations, and p5.js Canvas 2D score -> inline SVG text/mask plate with structural folds and negative glyph geometry
changedRule: A non-adjacent span between blank wells exerts pressure through the whole typographic plate; the blank produces remote letters rather than answering locally.
visibleConsequence: A valid span leaves the selected wells exact but changes a broad crease, distant glyph positions/scales/rotations/shear, one inherited form, and one actual counterform; later spans inherit the altered alphabet.
falsifier: Delete if one well changes geometry, adjacent wells commit, selected gaps answer themselves, pressure is only UI, the counterform is cosmetic, later folds reset, or exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v033 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish a material typographic plate from a decorated word or route diagram, or if negative space is not causally visible.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
